restore_order: Extract both feature archives into one day9 directory.
Extract Day9_Test_Evidence.zip last: features/manifest.json is the complete 16-scene authoritative manifest.
Extract Day9_Runtime_Validation.zip for raw precision evidence.
Restore the prior Day8 development caches, train_11000_dx+32 cache, frozen probe, and original Colab FP32 fixture for full selection/runtime reproduction.
scope: Code, reports and visual artifacts are Git-backed. Raw predictions and large feature caches are retained in the named archives; public model weights are not duplicated.
raw_archive_newline_note: Raw dev_candidates.csv preserves the computation CRLF bytes; the pretest Git copy used LF with identical rows and values.
